name: Shizel Steinbrecher
original_name: シゼル・ステインブレッシェル
source:
Member of the mercenary group, Fenrir with the rank of Major. Solder-like in disposition and with a preference for male mannerisms, she serves as Fenrir's attack captain. She is Eiji's most trusted subordinate, having known him for close to seven years.

She pilots the Simulacrum "Hraesvelgr".
